context: Evaluates the moveItem action in the navigation store, a pure in-memory operation that removes an item from a source level, conditionally inserts it at the destination, and collapses the navigation stack if the moved item is a notebook that is currently open. All three steps must correctly operate on the reactive stack without backend calls.

checklist.name: Source removal
checklist.description: The source NavLevel (found by stack.find matching its parentId) has its items array replaced with a filtered array that excludes the moved item by id.

checklist.name: Destination insertion
checklist.description: The destination NavLevel (found by matching its parentId to destinationParentId) is located in the stack, and the item is appended to its items array when found.

checklist.name: Notebook stack collapse
checklist.description: When item.kind === 'notebook', the store searches for a NavLevel whose parentId equals the item's id. If found at index openIdx, the stack is replaced with stack.slice(0, openIdx).

checklist.name: Kind-conditional collapse
checklist.description: The stack-collapse logic is guarded by item.kind === 'notebook' so that moving a note never triggers any stack modification.

checklist.name: In-memory only
checklist.description: moveItem contains no async/await and makes no backend API calls; it operates entirely through reactive stack mutations.
